research_notes: Follow up exact employers for early sales/state-manager roles, own-consultancy trading entity, music contracts, Paint Place employment versus consultancy and full-time hours, NRA engagement/cessation and all leave/overlaps. Missing hours prevent headline calculation.

Music, sales agency, NRA work, own consultancy, Paint Place projects and study overlap. These may include nested client assignments rather than separate simultaneous jobs. No durations summed and no management title treated as full-time proof.

Historical ACCC filing supports a commercial member-owned paint buying/marketing business, distinct from the NRA employer association. Current Paint Place's 2022 restructuring and current ABN are not used as the 2010–2018 legal employer identity.

Searched official biography/first speech, member site, employer-domain and annual-report terms, publisher testimonial, corporate/government records, historical training material, public professional-profile and full-time searches. No individual full-time evidence or complete sales/music employer list retrieved. Namesake spiritual medium, overseas business executives, school staff and recruitment consultants excluded.

A SkillsIQ July 2017 retail-training endorsement document indexes Angie Bell with NRA, after APH's 2015 end; original PDF returned 404. Treat as an unresolved affiliation lead, not an employment extension: https://www.skillsiq.com.au/site/DefaultSite/filesystem/documents/IRC/SIR%20V3.0%20Case%20for%20Endorsement%20July%202017.pdf . Last follow-up 2026-09-29.

Surf lifesaving, Rotary scholarship/honorary membership and other community participation do not establish paid employment. Publication and honours do not fill gaps or prove zero public/private experience.
